answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Work waits on the nectar until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the violet of the next round. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the ledge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
